main_text.l: Esto restituti sint a Ioanne, sed ipsi ante Ioa-
nnis prætensam restitutionem, & Synodos
abdicauerant, & irritas declarauerant. Et
Synodus, quæ similia adeo fidenter agit,
legitima fuerit? Nouum item est, & nun-
quam alias, nec ante, nec post tempora
Photij auditum, Ecclesiam Romanam semel
ab ipso in Ecclesia Synodali calculo appro-
batum reprobasse. Sed hæc quoque vti &
alia a Schismaticis, & Photianis immutata
fuisse indicio est; quod similia de condem-
natione dictorum, & factorum contra Pho-
tium in monumentis antiquis Græcorum
non habeantur. Constantinus Leonis, fra-
ter, qui magistro suo multum debuit Pho-
tio, Anno Domini 920. Indictione 4. post
restitutum Photium anno 43. & Acta huius
Synodi accurate scire poterat, in Tomo
Vnionis Synodicas acclamationes referens,
inter alia hæc quoque complectitur. Γερμανῦ, Ταρασίου, Νικηφόρου, καὶ Μεθοδίου, τῶν ἀοιδίμων [?] καὶ μακαρίων
Πατριαρχῶν αἰωνία ἡ μνήμη. Ἰγνατίου, Φωτίου, Στεφάνου, καὶ Αντωνίου. &c. Germani, Tarasij, Nicephori, & Methodij
celebrium beatorumq; Patriarcharum eterna sit
memoria. Ignatij, Photij, Stephani, & Antonij
&c. Tum subdit; Ἀπάντων τῶν ἁγίων Πατριαρχῶν Γερμανοῦ, Ταρασίου, Νικηφόρου,
Μεθοδίου γραφέντα [?], ἢ λαληθέντα ἀνάθεμα. Vniuersa
qua

page.notes: The Greek passages are read from a small, slightly blurred scan. Doubtful Greek letters and accents are marked [?] in the text, especially the epithets after "ἀοιδίμων" and the final verb forms; the Greek should be checked against the original. The line "Germani, Tarasij ..." is the Latin gloss to the Greek acclamation and is copied as printed. The printed hyphens at the line ends (fra-ter, Pho-tio) are kept as printed. The text ends mid-sentence with "Vniuersa" and the catchword "qua"; the sentence continues on the next page. No running head, marginal notes or signature are printed on this page.
